projects.title: Legacy systems, brought into focus.
projects.description: Register a local Java web source tree, establish a traceable inventory, and decide what deserves investigation next.
projects.registryHint: Each project keeps independent scans, evidence, and reports.
projects.emptyDescription: Add an existing Java web source directory. The backend validates the path before any inventory starts.
projects.accessTitle: The browser never walks your filesystem.
projects.accessDescription: Inventory scans run in the local backend and must resolve beneath configured roots. Symlinks are not followed, and source mutation is not part of the inventory API.
projects.createDescription: Point Stravique at an existing source directory. Project metadata can be corrected after the first scan.

form.name: Project name
form.sourcePathHint: The directory is resolved and validated by the backend before registration.
form.descriptionPlaceholder: Purpose, ownership, or current investigation context

overview.defaultDescription: Evidence-backed status for this legacy system.
overview.noScanDescription: Start a read-only inventory to establish modules, file types, framework usage, and review items.
overview.scanInProgress: The backend is walking and analyzing this source tree.

nextActions.WAIT_FOR_SCAN: Wait for the active scan to reach a persisted terminal state.
nextActions.RETRY_SCAN: Inspect the failed scan, adjust the source or policy, then retry.
nextActions.REVIEW_PARSE_FAILURES: Resolve parser failures before trusting framework totals.
nextActions.REVIEW_UNCERTAINTIES: Review dynamic and convention-based findings before migration planning.
nextActions.INSPECT_RESULTS: Explore the evidence and framework usage before defining the next analysis phase.

overview.noTechnology: No technology evidence is available for this scan.
overview.noReviewDescription: The current scan did not persist review-required or parse-failed evidence.
overview.compositionTitle: What this system is made of

inventory.title: Follow every result to its source.
inventory.description: Browse the persisted scan tree, inspect files, and verify findings against exact line evidence.
inventory.noScanTitle: Inventory is waiting for a scan
inventory.noScanDescription: Run a read-only scan to populate the repository tree and evidence inspector.
inventory.noMatchesDescription: Clear the search or choose a different directory, type, or analysis state.
inventory.noReviewsTitle: No review items in this scan
inventory.noReviewsDescription: Unresolved, inferred, and parse-failed findings will appear here.
inventory.inspectorPlaceholder: Select a file to inspect its metadata, parse state, rules, and source evidence.
inventory.noEvidence: No framework or configuration evidence was persisted for this file.
inventory.noRelations: No evidence-backed cross-file relation was persisted for this file.

frameworks.title: Separate signals from confirmed use.
frameworks.description: Inspect framework, build, web, and data-access evidence with its certainty and source location.
frameworks.noScanDescription: Run the first scan to identify dependencies, APIs, configuration, and custom tag usage.
frameworks.emptyDescription: The scan completed without matching the configured technology and framework rules.
frameworks.interpretationDeclared: Only dependency declarations were found. This does not establish runtime use.
frameworks.interpretationAnalyzed: Static API or configuration evidence was parsed, but runtime branch execution is not implied.
frameworks.noEvidence: The aggregate exists, but no individual evidence rows were returned.

reports.title: Export the evidence you actually have.
reports.description: Every report is generated from persisted scan rows and can be exported as CSV, JSON, or Markdown.
reports.policyTitle: Persistence is the source of truth
reports.policyDescription: Report counts use the same rows as the exported documents. No client-side totals or placeholder findings are added.
reports.noScanDescription: Complete an inventory scan before exporting files, structure, technology, or review reports.
reports.catalogDescription: Choose a report and format. Empty results remain explicit in the exported file.

FILES.title: File inventory
FILES.description: Paths, types, encoding, parse state, hashes, and change classification.

STRUCTURE.title: Project structure
STRUCTURE.description: Modules and detected source, test, web, resource, configuration, and SQL roots.

TECHNOLOGY.title: Technology stack
TECHNOLOGY.description: Aggregated technology signals with API, configuration, and dependency evidence counts.

FRAMEWORKS.title: Framework API usage
FRAMEWORKS.description: Persisted framework API and configuration findings with paths, lines, and rule IDs.

CONFIGURATION.title: Configuration inventory
CONFIGURATION.description: Parsed configuration findings, class references, dicon components, and tag libraries.

PARSE_ERRORS.title: Parse exceptions
PARSE_ERRORS.description: Files and records where the configured parser could not provide a trustworthy result.

REVIEWS.title: Review queue
REVIEWS.description: Inferred, unresolved, review-required, and parse-failed findings.

settings.title: Correct what automation cannot know.
settings.description: Refine project metadata, exclusions, and structural assumptions without touching the source tree.
settings.identityDescription: These values describe the investigation; scanning never rewrites the source directory.
settings.stackDescription: Detected values can be corrected. Existing scan records remain unchanged.
settings.scopeDescription: Add one directory name, relative path, or glob per line. Defaults still apply.
settings.defaultExclusions: Build output, VCS metadata, dependencies, and common generated paths are excluded by default.
settings.pathPolicyDescription: Only these local roots are eligible for read-only scanning.
settings.overridesDescription: Use explicit roles when conventions cannot reliably classify a directory. Overrides affect future scans.
settings.auditDescription: Persisted local operations for this project, including scans, corrections, and exports.
settings.auditEmpty: No audit events have been recorded for this project.
